qualification.title: Assistant Electrician
qualification.sector_skill_council: IISSSC (Indian Iron & Steel Sector Skill Council)

nos.title: Use basic health and safety practices at the work place
Prepare for machines/electrical panels assembling activities

pcs.text: use wires strippers, crippling tool and other insulated tools for making the electrical connections of machine/electrical panels
pcs.source_note: Verbatim from NQR Q-File, Assistant Electrician (original spelling retained) [4]

rubric.author_note: Team-drafted PC-level analytic rubric (Jonsson & Svingby 2007 [8]). To be validated with SSC-certified assessors before pilot scoring.

levels.descriptor: Not demonstrated. No observable use of stripping, crimping or insulated tools to make a connection in the evidence.
Attempted, unsafe or incorrect. Wrong or non-insulated tool used, conductor strands visibly damaged, or the connection is not completed without intervention.
Partially correct. Appropriate tools chosen, but strip length or crimp is inconsistent, strands are loose or nicked, or safe handling lapses once.
Correct and safe. Appropriate insulated tools used safely; insulation stripped to suitable length; lug/ferrule crimped and terminated securely. Minor inefficiency or one small rework.
Correct, safe and fluent throughout. Clean strip with no strand damage, properly crimped and seated lugs, secure terminations, insulated grip maintained, no rework.
